name: SE Ranking
oneLiner: SEO and AI-visibility platform for rank tracking, site audits and backlink research. Core is $129/mo ($103.20/mo annual); Growth is $279/mo ($223.20/mo annual).
summary: SE Ranking is an SEO and AI-visibility platform for rank tracking, site audits, backlink research and reporting, sold as two self-serve plans (Core and Growth) plus a custom Enterprise tier. Core costs $129/month (or $103.20/month billed annually) with 1 seat and 2,000 tracked keywords/day; Growth costs $279/month (or $223.20/month billed annually) with 3 seats and 5,000 tracked keywords/day. Optional add-ons cover extra seats, extra tracked keywords, an agency white-label pack, AI-search visibility tracking and API access.
notFor: Teams needing more than 3 seats without paying per-seat add-on fees outside a negotiated Enterprise contract
Buyers who want month-to-month billing on the Agency Pack or API add-on
pros: 14-day free trial with no credit card required, including Agency Pack and AI Search add-on access during the trial
Both self-serve plans include AI Overviews/AI Mode/ChatGPT/Perplexity tracking and MCP access built in, not sold as a separate add-on tier
Free assisted migration from another SEO platform when paying annually
Extra manager seats ($20/month) and extra tracked keywords (from $22.40-$32/month) can be added incrementally instead of forcing a jump to the next plan
cons: Only 1 manager seat is included on Core ($129/mo); a 2nd user costs $20/month more
The Agency Pack and API add-on can only be bought on an annual subscription, even though the base plans also offer monthly billing
The pricing page and SE Ranking's own Agency Pack help article disagree on how many client seats the Agency Pack includes (30 vs. up to 10)
Legacy Essential/Pro/Business customers keep older limits and pricing that are no longer published anywhere on the current site
Enterprise has no list price, seat count or keyword allowance on the pricing page itself; the only published seat/keyword figures for it come from Help Center articles that group it with Core/Growth
PayPal isn't accepted; all billing runs through Stripe, and accounts still on 2Checkout must migrate during 2026
